[EN] Moment of Truth
[ES] El momento de la verdad
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "It's Paesyn. Of course I'll help."
[ES] "Es Paesyn. Por supuesto que ayudaré."
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "Are you actually worried about him?"
[ES] "¿De verdad te preocupa él?"
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "I haven't seen him in a while."
[ES] "No lo he visto en un buen rato."
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Find Zolyn and talk to her.
[ES] Encuentra a Zolyn y habla con ella.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "He's more capable than you think. But yes, I'll help."
[ES] "Él es más capaz de lo que crees. Pero sí, ayudaré."
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "Looks like he went this way."
[ES] "Parece que se fue por aquí."
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Look for Paesyn's trail.
[ES] Busca el rastro de Paesyn.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "He was running from something..."
[ES] "Estaba huyendo de algo..."
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Look for Paesyn's trail.
[ES] Busca el rastro de Paesyn.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Save Paesyn from the monsters.
[ES] Salva a Paesyn de los monstruos.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "This is the last time, right? Then okay."
[ES] "Esta es la última vez, ¿verdad? Entonces de acuerdo."
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Talk to Paesyn.
[ES] Habla con Paesyn.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "I think you just made his day, Zolyn."
[ES] "Creo que le alegraste el día, Zolyn."
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Deliver the bouquet of flowers to Zolyn.
[ES] Entrégale el ramo de flores a Zolyn.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "She does seem a lot less murder-y. Well done, Paesyn."
[ES] "Ella se ve mucho menos sanguinaria. Bien hecho, Paesyn."
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Talk to Paesyn.
[ES] Habla con Paesyn.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "Sounds good. Take care, Paesyn!"
[ES] "Me parece bien. ¡Cuídate, Paesyn!"
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Speak with Zolyn.
[ES] Habla con Zolyn.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026
